7e21cff522a3d032.description: About the Role Dallah Digital, a subsidiary of Dallah Albaraka Holding, is seeking a Cloud Infrastructure Administrator to join its team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for the design, implementation, administration, and maintenance of Microsoft cloud infrastructure and productivity platforms. The position ensures the availability, security, performance, and continuity of cloud services, while also supporting infrastructure improvements, cloud migrations, technical operations, and IT projects in alignment with organizational policies and security requirements. Key Responsibilities Provision, configure, administer, monitor, and maintain Microsoft Azure infrastructure, including virtual machines, networks, storage, servers, backup, and recovery services. Administer Microsoft 365 services, such as Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, and Microsoft Teams. Manage Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory, covering identities, user access, authentication, Conditional Access, enterprise applications, and privileged access controls. Implement cloud security and compliance controls using Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Defender, Sophos, vulnerability management, and security updates. Monitor cloud service availability, capacity, and performance; troubleshoot complex incidents; and provide Level 3 (L3) technical support across Microsoft 365, Intune, Entra ID, and Active Directory environments. Maintain backup, retention, recovery, and disaster recovery arrangements to support business continuity and protect critical systems and data. Support cloud adoption, infrastructure migrations, Microsoft 365 tenant configurations, system integrations, cross-tenant synchronization, and cross-tenant migrations. Utilize PowerShell, scripting, and automation tools to enhance administrative efficiency, operational consistency, and cloud resource and cost optimization. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve cloud services, collaboration platforms, system performance, and user experience. Execute IT infrastructure projects and maintain accurate technical documentation, system configurations, procedures, and operational standards. Develop and implement IT infrastructure policies, standards, and procedures aligned with National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) guidelines and applicable security requirements. Perform regular system maintenance, upgrades, security updates, and technical improvements to ensure infrastructure stability and reliability. Coordinate with IT management, infrastructure, network, security, application, end-user support teams, Microsoft Support, and external service providers to resolve complex technical issues. Serve as a technical escalation point and provide Microsoft 365 support to Dallah Digital's sister companies as required. Experience and Qualifications Candidates for this position should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in cloud infrastructure administration, specifically with Microsoft technologies. Work Location This full-time position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia.

The primary objective is to maximize short-term and long-term sales performance, with a focus on patient well-being, while operating within AbbVie’s business code of conduct, policies, and all applicable laws and regulations. Develop pre-call plans using SMART objectives and conduct post-call evaluations to continuously enhance sales performance. Effectively manage objections, misunderstandings, and concerns, consistently securing logical and reasonable calls to action during sales interactions. Proactively address customer needs, expectations, and challenges to build trusted relationships and achieve mutually beneficial agreements. Create and implement a call plan that meets established call metrics and optimizes coverage and frequency to key customers, maximizing access and sales opportunities. Continuously develop understanding of customer needs, market landscape, competitors, market segments, accounts, disease states, product knowledge, clinical data, and sales expertise. Share market intelligence with the in-field team, brand team, and sales manager to ensure alignment, anticipate environmental changes, and optimize brand strategy and execution. Differentiate AbbVie’s value proposition with assigned healthcare providers and identify, develop, and maintain relationships with disease state experts and speakers/advocates to maximize brand performance. 7efb238790855315.description: تبحث شركتنا عن خياطة ماهرة للانضمام إلى فريقنا، حيث ستكون مسؤولة عن تنفيذ مجموعة متنوعة من مهام الخياطة بدقة واحترافية. تتطلب الوظيفة خبرة في استخدام آلات الخياطة المختلفة والقدرة على قراءة وفهم أنماط الخياطة. إذا كنت تمتلكين الشغف بالخياطة وتبحثين عن فرصة عمل مجزية، فإننا ندعوك للتقديم. المهام الرئيسية: * تنفيذ عمليات القص والخياطة للتصاميم المختلفة. * التعامل مع مختلف أنواع الأقمشة بدقة وعناية. * الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والمواعيد النهائية للتسليم.

7e6b468bfe90a0fa.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات للمشاريع الهندسية الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى تطوير برامج التركيب والتشغيل والصيانة للمعدات والتجهيزات الصناعية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات التفصيلية لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات توزيع أنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات الصناعية وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية، مع الالتزام بتعليمات الشركات المصنعة ومتابعة تنفيذها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوثيق نسب التقدم، وعرضها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية بدقة. معرفة قوية ببرامج تجميع وتركيب وتشغيل التجهيزات الميكانيكية. فهم لبرامج الصيانة الوقائية للمعدات الصناعية. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الميكانيكي ضمن فريق شركة المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات في مدينة الرياض، في بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب الالتزام بالمعايير الهندسية والجودة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. معلومات إضافية المنطقة: الرياض نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل الراتب: غير معلن التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

7eb497716e39cdd1.description: About the Role Schneider Electric is seeking a Generalist Service Representative I to join their team in Al Madinah, covering both Yanbu and Medina. This full-time position is responsible for the installation, inspection, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of customer equipment. The role requires 0-1 years of experience and involves providing technical support for Schneider Electric products, both in the shop and on-site, with potential work on competitive equipment. Key Responsibilities Comply with all safety and cybersecurity policies, practices, and procedures. Perform startup and commissioning for Schneider Electric products and potentially competitive equipment. Conduct preventive, scheduled, and unscheduled maintenance on equipment. Analyze and interpret technical procedures, governmental regulations, and equipment issues to provide appropriate solutions. Analyze and explain report results to customers and management. Participate proactively in team initiatives and management meetings to achieve departmental and company goals. Understand the scope of work, adhere to time allocations, and ensure full traceability through timesheets and change orders. Support planners, coordinators, and project managers in understanding customer site conditions. Escalate quality or technical issues detected in the field. Understand the EcoStruxure offer and provide technical explanations to customers. Utilize all digital tools designed for Schneider Electric Field Service Representatives (FSRs). Track the installed base of serviceable assets. Advise customers on opportunities to optimize their installed base and generate business leads. Perform basic audits of customer electrical systems and equipment (MPS walkthrough). Execute Field Services Operations, ensuring a high level of customer experience and promoting Schneider Electric's services. Technical Support and Field Operations The FSR will maintain, retrofit, and provide technical support for all Schneider products. Collaboration with the commercial team is also a key aspect of the position. Key Success Factors Strong Customer Orientation: A mindset focused on delivering excellent customer service. Technical Knowledge: Solid understanding of Schneider Electric products and serviceable assets. Continuous Learning: Willingness to acquire new technical, digital, and soft skills. Collaborative Attitude: Effective teamwork with internal entities such as planners, inside sales, and technical support. Digital Tool Proficiency: Consistent use of all digital tools designed for Schneider Electric FSRs. Performance Metrics Performance will be measured by adherence to safety processes, proper use of PPE, cybersecurity compliance, timesheet accuracy, tracking of assets, lead generation, and adoption of FSR digital tools such as ServicesMax GO, Enablon, and Onsite.

7e7814c76267cb11.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث فندق سوفيتيل جبل عمر عن موظف استقبال فندق للانضمام إلى فريقه في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تقديم خدمات إرشاد ومساعدة متميزة للنزلاء، وتلبية طلباتهم، وتنسيق الحجوزات والمواصلات، وتوفير المعلومات السياحية والخدمات الفندقية. يضمن شاغل الوظيفة تجربة إقامة مميزة ورضا النزلاء وفقًا لمعايير الفندق. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال النزلاء والترحيب بهم وتقديم المساعدة اللازمة أثناء إقامتهم. تقديم المعلومات المتعلقة بمرافق الفندق والخدمات المتاحة. تنسيق حجوزات المطاعم والمواصلات والجولات السياحية حسب طلب النزلاء. مساعدة النزلاء في تلبية احتياجاتهم الخاصة وتقديم التوصيات المناسبة. التعامل مع استفسارات النزلاء وطلباتهم ومتابعتها لضمان رضاهم. التنسيق مع الأقسام المعنية لضمان تقديم الخدمات بكفاءة وسرعة. تقديم معلومات دقيقة عن المعالم السياحية والمواقع المهمة في المنطقة. التعامل مع الشكاوى والملاحظات باحترافية وإحالتها إلى المسؤول المختص عند الحاجة. الالتزام بمعايير الخدمة والضيافة والمظهر المهني المعتمدة في الفندق. المحافظة على سرية معلومات النزلاء وخصوصيتهم. متابعة الطلبات الخاصة والتأكد من تنفيذها في الوقت المحدد. توثيق طلبات النزلاء والملاحظات المهمة وتسليمها للموظفين في المناوبات التالية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة. مهارات تواصل قوية ولباقة في التعامل. بيئة العمل يعمل موظف الاستقبال ضمن فريق فندق سوفيتيل جبل عمر في مدينة مكة المكرمة، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بمعايير الضيافة الفندقية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

7e5a98f7044646b9.description: Eram Talent, a division of ERAM Group, is seeking a skilled Botanic Garden Maintenance Specialist to join our team in the Oil & Energy industry. As an independent Talent Acquisition Consultancy, Eram Talent is dedicated to providing outstanding recruitment solutions that satisfy the needs of our clients. With a global reach and network, we specialize in attracting high-potential professionals with sophisticated skills from various industries, including Oil & Gas, Petroleum, Infrastructure, Energy, Water, Transportation, Science & Technology, and Health Care. The Botanic Garden Maintenance Specialist is responsible for the specialised maintenance, environmental management, and ongoing health of botanic collections, with particular emphasis on rare, delicate, and environmentally sensitive plant species. The role ensures that greenhouses, conservatories, specialised plant zones, and associated horticulture systems maintain optimal growing conditions through systematic monitoring, preventative maintenance, and precise environmental control. The Specialist combines horticulture expertise with technical maintenance capabilities to manage temperature, humidity, lighting, irrigation, nutrient delivery, soil and substrate conditions, and specialised horticulture equipment. The role also implements rigorous greenhouse cleaning and sterilisation procedures, and maintains detailed records to support the long-term health, conservation, and integrity of botanic collections. Bachelor's degree in Horticulture, Botany, Plant Sciences, or a related discipline. Specialist training or certification in greenhouse management, controlled-environment horticulture, irrigation systems, plant health, horticulture equipment maintenance, or related disciplines is advantageous. Fluency in English and Arabic is required. Minimum 5+ years of relevant professional experience in botanic garden maintenance or a comparable horticulture environment. Demonstrated experience maintaining botanic gardens, greenhouses, conservatories, specialised plant collections, or similar horticulture facilities. Proven experience maintaining optimal growing conditions for rare, delicate, sensitive, or high-value plant species. Practical experience monitoring and controlling greenhouse or conservatory environmental conditions, including temperature, humidity, lighting, and ventilation. Experience conducting comprehensive plant-health assessments and implementing appropriate corrective measures. Experience managing irrigation systems and nutrient-delivery programmes for diverse botanic collections. Practical experience in soil-health, growing-media, and substrate management for different plant requirements. Experience implementing greenhouse cleaning, sanitation, sterilisation, and biosecurity procedures. Experience with Integrated Pest Management and preventative plant-health programmes. Demonstrated experience operating and maintaining environmental monitoring equipment and horticulture control systems. Practical experience in the inspection, troubleshooting, repair, and calibration of specialised horticulture equipment and monitoring systems. Experience maintaining detailed records of plant health, environmental conditions, maintenance activities, treatments, and equipment performance. Experience developing or implementing preventative and seasonal maintenance schedules for indoor and specialised botanic areas. Experience coordinating maintenance activities with horticulture teams, facilities personnel, contractors, and other technical specialists. Previous experience within a botanic garden, conservatory, greenhouse complex, major public garden, research facility, or comparable specialist horticulture environment is preferred.

7e89ce58438158d9.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة معين للموارد البشرية عن أخصائي عمليات موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، ويركز على تنفيذ ومتابعة الإجراءات المتعلقة بعمليات الموارد البشرية لضمان الامتثال للسياسات الداخلية والأنظمة المعتمدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ ومتابعة الإجراءات والأنظمة والنماذج الخاصة بمراقبة دوام موظفي الفروع وإجازاتهم بأنواعها المختلفة، وتعديل النماذج عند الحاجة. تطبيق نظام مراقبة الحضور والتأكد من التزام الموظفين بأوقات الدوام الرسمي. تطبيق سياسات وإجراءات الإجازات السنوية والمرضية والطارئة وغيرها من الإجازات المحددة في سياسة العطل والإجازات المعتمدة. تطبيق إجراءات الترقيات والإعارة وانتهاء الخدمة، وتسجيل كافة وقوعات الموظفين وفقاً للأنظمة والإجراءات المعتمدة. التعامل مع شكاوى وملاحظات وطلبات واستفسارات الموظفين بطريقة مهنية، ورفع المشاكل إلى مدير الإدارة عند الضرورة. تحديث المعلومات المتعلقة بالموظفين وتزويدها لفريق خدمات الموظفين، من خلال تسجيل وتوثيق جميع البيانات مثل الترقيات والدورات التدريبية والأمور المتعلقة بالرواتب والامتيازات. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بعمليات الموارد البشرية، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال عمليات الموارد البشرية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على فهم وتطبيق سياسات وإجراءات الموارد البشرية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتعامل مع استفسارات وشكاوى الموظفين. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق بدقة. مهارات تنظيمية عالية والقدرة على إدارة البيانات والمعلومات. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، وتتطلب الوظيفة التزاماً بالعمل بدوام كامل ضمن فريق عمليات الموارد البشرية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

7eff37d10e412883.job_title: Principal Cloud Operations Engineer (GCP Managed Services) (m/f/d)
7eff37d10e412883.description: About the Role Site سايت is seeking a Senior Technical Lead Cloud Engineering to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves leading the technical delivery of cloud projects and ensuring successful implementation for client onboarding. The position requires strong technical knowledge across various cloud platforms, IT infrastructure, operating systems, networking, and migration technologies, along with effective coordination with customers and internal teams. Key Responsibilities Lead the technical delivery of cloud projects from planning and implementation through to customer acceptance and handover. Review the Scope of Work (SoW) to ensure all technical requirements and deliverables are clearly defined. Serve as the main technical point of contact for assigned customers. Conduct technical discovery and assessments of customer infrastructure, applications, and dependencies. Prepare and review technical designs, implementation plans, and migration strategies. Coordinate with internal teams, vendors, and customers to ensure successful project delivery. Deliver cloud onboarding activities, including resource provisioning, networking, connectivity, and service configuration. Plan and execute workload migrations from on-premises environments or other cloud platforms. Implement backup and disaster recovery solutions, including DR testing, failover, and failback. Support the deployment and integration of enterprise services such as Active Directory, DNS, email, databases, and application hosting. Troubleshoot complex technical issues and resolve delivery challenges. Identify technical risks, dependencies, and scope gaps that may impact project delivery. Ensure technical documentation, knowledge transfer, and operational handover are completed. Support technical discussions, solution assessments, and delivery planning. Improve delivery processes through automation, standardization, and knowledge sharing. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. Minimum of 6 years of experience in cloud engineering, IT infrastructure, or technical project delivery. Proven experience leading technical projects and working directly with enterprise customers. Strong knowledge of cloud platforms, including private, public, and hybrid cloud environments. Hands-on experience with virtualization, compute, storage, and backup technologies. Strong experience with Windows Server and Linux administration and troubleshooting. Good understanding of networking, including routing, firewalls, VPN, NAT, DNS, and load balancing. Experience with cloud migrations, customer onboarding, and disaster recovery implementation. Broad knowledge of enterprise IT services, including Active Directory, email, databases, and application infrastructure. Understanding of IT security, access management, and infrastructure best practices. Familiarity with automation and scripting tools such as PowerShell, Bash, Ansible, or Terraform. Strong communication, problem-solving, documentation, and customer management skills. Ability to manage multiple projects, coordinate technical teams, and work under pressure. Preferred Qualifications Experience working with a cloud service provider, system integrator, or IT consulting company. Professional certifications in cloud or infrastructure technologies, such as AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, VMware, Red Hat, or Cisco. Experience with Kubernetes, OpenShift, or other container platforms. Application Process Candidates meeting the specified requirements are encouraged to apply.

7e7740622b99264f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة معين للموارد البشرية عن مترجم فوري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى المترجم الفوري مسؤولية ترجمة المحادثات والتصريحات في مختلف الفعاليات ووسائل الإعلام بشكل فوري ودقيق، مع الالتزام بالأمانة في نقل أقوال المتحدثين. يشمل الدور أيضاً إعداد وحفظ الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة في مجال الترجمة الفورية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة أصول وقواعد ومصطلحات اللغة الأم من حيث المرادفات والصرف والنحو، بالإضافة إلى دراسة اللغة الأجنبية من حيث مفرداتها وتراكيبها واشتقاقاتها. إجراء الترجمة الفورية لمداخلات المتحدثين في الندوات والمؤتمرات وورش العمل. تنفيذ الترجمة الفورية لما يُنقل في وسائل الإعلام من تصريحات سياسية أو لقاءات مع أفراد في برامج محددة. مواكبة التطورات في المصطلحات المستخدمة في كل من اللغة الأم واللغة الأجنبية التي تتم الترجمة إليها. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة في مجال الترجمة الفورية وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة، بما يتوافق مع السياسات والإجراءات المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الترجمة الفورية أو مجال ذي صلة. إتقان تام للغتين العربية والإنجليزية (أو اللغات المطلوبة الأخرى) تحدثاً وكتابةً. القدرة على الترجمة الفورية بدقة وأمانة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض. يعمل المترجم الفوري ضمن بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب الاستجابة السريعة والدقة في نقل المعلومات عبر اللغات المختلفة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

7e9546345f26944a.description: Government Relations Specialist Location: Makkah, Saudi Arabia Department: Shared Services Department Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Government Relations Specialist to manage and follow up on government transactions related to the company's real estate development projects in the Western Region. 7eae6d826dc45e26.job_title: Civil Engineer for Execution, Finishing, and Facilitation
7eae6d826dc45e26.description: Job description We are looking for a comprehensive civil engineer to manage execution, finishing, and facilitation tasks. The ideal candidate should possess a strong field experience combined with commercial and financial capabilities. This role requires the ability to oversee project progress from the study of plans and facilitation to execution and final delivery. The selection will be based on the candidates' experience, previous projects, practical tests, and professional reviews. Benefits: Basic salary: to be discussed after the interview. Housing: provided by the company. Transportation: provided by the company. Medical insurance: covered by the company. One-year work contract, renewable. Work location: Qatif, Dammam, Khobar, depending on the projects. Opportunities for continuous development based on performance and project results. Responsibilities: Overseeing execution and finishing tasks. Application Procedure: Applications will not be considered if the CV is incomplete or if submitted alone without the required documents. Applicants should send via WhatsApp: CV in PDF format. Total years of experience and Saudi experience. Current city. Residency status and ability to transfer services. Device availability. Names of at least three previous projects. Value, duration, and role in each project. Photos of execution and finishing works. Non-confidential BOQ or quantity take-off samples. Non-confidential price analysis samples. Example of a cost report or project summary. Reference contacts. Confirmation of salary acceptance and disclosed benefits. It is prohibited to send documents or images containing confidential information related to previous employers or employees. Selection Stages: Review of CV and projects. Verification of documents and experiences. Practical test in finishing tasks. Quantity take-off and BOQ test. Pricing and price analysis test. Cost and project summary test. Comparison of contractor bids. Oral discussion for solutions and calculations. Verification of professional references. Final interview with top candidates. Tests are based on hypothetical scenarios for evaluation purposes and are not free services for the company's projects. Success Criteria: The overall score should not be less than 80 out of 100. Finishing tasks should not be less than 20 out of 25. Quantity take-offs should not be less than 16 out of 20. Cost and pricing should not be less than 15 out of 20. Passing the verification of projects and references. The job offer will be presented to the highest-ranked candidate after passing all stages. Contact: Applications via WhatsApp only: Company: Innovative Raqi for Contracting. Skills Study of plans and specifications before execution. Supervision of concrete works, masonry, and finishing. Monitoring of plastering, tiling, and ceiling works. Coordination of electrical, plumbing, and HVAC works. Quality control of finishing works and defect rectification. Preparation and review of BOQ. Price analysis of materials, labor, and equipment. Pricing of projects and tenders. Review of contractor and supplier bids. Take-off of executed and additional works. Preparation and review of summaries. Contractors and Labor: Searching for subcontractors and suppliers. Requesting price quotations and negotiating them. Comparing bids technically and financially. Distributing labor and monitoring productivity. Monitoring subcontractors' quality and schedule adherence. Preventing waste and reallocating unapproved costs. Cost and Pricing: Preparing budgets for each project. Monitoring actual expenses and commitments. Determining contractors' and suppliers' entitlements. Preparing required project documentation. Preparing cost reports for upcoming weeks. Comparing actual costs with budgets. Calculating remaining costs until delivery. Preparing profit or loss estimates for each project. Monitoring project revenues and collected amounts. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering. Minimum 7 years of overall experience. At least 3 years of experience within Saudi Arabia. Strong experience in execution and finishing of projects. Experience in quantity take-off, BOQ, pricing, and price analysis. Familiarity with market prices in Saudi Arabia. Proficiency in Excel, AutoCAD, and project management software. Active membership in the Saudi Council of Engineers. Ability to manage multiple projects. For non-Saudis: residency permit and ability to transfer services. Leadership qualities and strong negotiation skills.

7edeef33197ab725.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة بينان المثالية التجارية عن بائع ملابس جاهزة للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم تجربة تسوق مميزة للعملاء من خلال عرض المنتجات وتقديم المعلومات اللازمة حولها، بالإضافة إلى إدارة عمليات البيع والدفع. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بيع مجموعة متنوعة من الملابس الجاهزة للزبائن. توفير معلومات دقيقة وشاملة للعملاء حول المنتجات، بما في ذلك الاستخدامات والأسعار. مراقبة مستويات المخزون بانتظام وضمان ترتيب المتجر بشكل مستمر. إصدار طلبات شراء المنتجات الجديدة والتعامل مع المنتجات الواردة بكفاءة. إدارة عمليات الدفع وتلقي المدفوعات من الزبائن. معالجة طلبات استبدال المنتجات والمرتجعات وفقاً للسياسات المعتمدة للشركة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال بيع الملابس أو التجزئة. القدرة على التعامل مع أنظمة نقاط البيع (POS) وإدارة المعاملات المالية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لتقديم خدمة عملاء احترافية. بيئة العمل يعمل بائع الملابس الجاهزة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق المبيعات في متجر الشركة بالخبر، المنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء والحفاظ على بيئة عمل منظمة وجذابة. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. المنطقة: المنطقة الشرقية، الخبر. الراتب: غير معلن. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

7ee415a17a87be0c.job_title: Consultant Manager Cyber Operate Third Party Risk Assessor
7ee415a17a87be0c.description: About Deloitte Deloitte is a global professional services firm recognized for its impact on clients, people, and society. The firm has received awards including Best Employer in the Middle East and Best Consulting Firm. Deloitte focuses on delivering innovative insights, solving complex challenges, and fostering sustainable growth through its talented professionals and a culture of inclusion and collaboration. The Role: Consultant Manager Cyber Operate Third Party Risk Assessor Deloitte is seeking a Consultant Manager Cyber Operate Third Party Risk Assessor to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires 2-5 years of experience and involves developing and managing third-party and supply chain cybersecurity risk management frameworks. The successful candidate will contribute to building confidence and trust in markets by upholding organizational integrity and supporting communities. Key Responsibilities Design and maintain the Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) framework, including scope, roles, RACI, risk tiering, assessment depth, and risk rating methodology. Develop and maintain third-party cybersecurity policies, processes, procedures, and SOPs for each lifecycle stage. Build supporting toolkits such as tiered questionnaires, evidence checklists, assessment templates, and standard contract clauses. Embed TPRM steps into procurement and contract management processes to ensure cybersecurity assessments for high-risk suppliers. Define TPRM KPIs and KRIs, and regularly update the framework based on new requirements, incidents, and lessons learned. Manage the third-party risk lifecycle, including tiering, due diligence, periodic reassessments, and secure offboarding. Assess third parties by reviewing security questionnaires, evidence (*, ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2 reports), and conducting remote/on-site assessments. Manage supply chain cybersecurity risk by mapping critical supply chains, setting requirements for secure development, and ensuring incident response plans. Define and review standard cybersecurity and data protection clauses in contracts with Procurement and Legal. Track supplier remediation actions, monitor critical suppliers, maintain the third-party inventory and risk register, and report risk posture to management. Leadership Capabilities Demonstrates an understanding of the firm's purpose and values, seeking opportunities for impact. Commits to personal learning and development, acting as a brand ambassador. Understands expectations and takes accountability for performance. Develops effective communication and relationship-building skills. Understands how daily work contributes to team and business priorities. Experience Required Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in cyber security, third-party risk management, or a related field. The role requires a strong understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and practices, particularly in assessing and managing risks associated with third-party vendors and supply chains. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a collaborative culture focused on delivering value to clients and contributing to society.

7edbb7bc269ec16c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مشاتل العاصمة الحديثة عن سائق شاحنة صغيرة للانضمام إلى فريقها في ينبع، المدينة المنورة. يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية تشغيل وقيادة الشاحنة وفقًا للمسارات المحددة وقواعد المرور والسلامة، بالإضافة إلى إجراء الفحوصات الدورية ورفع طلبات الصيانة اللازمة. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تشغيل وقيادة الشاحنة والتقيد بمسارات العمل الموضوعة وفق خطط العمل المتبعة. الالتزام التام بقواعد المرور والأمن والسلامة، والتنبه لعدم ارتكاب المخالفات النظامية. إجراء فحوصات دورية على الشاحنة ومعالجة الأمور والمشكلات البسيطة التي قد تقع عليها. رفع طلبات الصيانة التي تتطلب فحص الخبراء عند ملاحظة أي خلل. الالتزام التام بأدلة الإجراءات وأدلة المواصفات والمعايير وسياسات وقواعد السلامة العامة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين خمس وعشر سنوات في تشغيل المعدات الثقيلة كالشاحنات القلابة والحفارات والمقطورات والحافلات. الكفاءة في توجيه عمل مشغلي المعدات الثقيلة في الحالات الطارئة. امتلاك رخصة قيادة سعودية سارية المفعول للنقل الثقيل أو المعدات. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة مشاتل العاصمة الحديثة في ينبع، المدينة المنورة. يتطلب الدور الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة في جميع الأوقات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

7e5d76001a081ad1.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ساس البلد للتشغيل والصيانة عن فني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تركيب وصيانة وإصلاح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية، بما في ذلك وحدات التدفئة ومضخاتها ومكيفات الهواء. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية تصميم نظم التهوية وتكييف الهواء والتدفئة بشكل عام، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة. تقديم الدعم للمشروعات الهندسية، والإشراف على تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم، ووضع الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة. تقديم الدعم في أعمال الصيانة وتصليح النظم لضمان استمرارية الأداء. مراقبة الجوانب الفنية المتعلقة بإنتاج وتركيب واستعمال وصيانة منظومات وأجهزة ومعدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف، للتأكد من دقة الأداء ومطابقة المواصفات. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء. القدرة على تركيب وصيانة وإصلاح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية. معرفة جيدة بمعايير الجودة وسياسات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. بيئة العمل يعمل فني التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف في مدينة الرياض ضمن فريق شركة ساس البلد للتشغيل والصيانة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بجدول العمل المحدد. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

Responsibilities · Inspect softscape and hardscape, planting and landscape-related works in accordance with approved Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs). · Verify materials and plant quality against the project specifications, before and after installation. · Witness relevant tests, and raise and track Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) through to verified close-out. · Apply standardised inspection checklists, protocols and reporting templates consistently across sites, and complete inspections to the agreed schedule. · Maintain full inspection records and support quality reporting, flagging recurring issues early so they can be addressed before they spread across the programme. · Support snagging and punch-list close-out, and the handover of public-realm assets, including checking as-built records against what was actually built. Requirements · Diploma or degree in Landscape Architecture, Agriculture or Civil Engineering. · Over 7 years' relevant experience with a degree, or 12 years' relevant experience in lieu of a degree · Hands-on inspection experience on landscape and public-realm works — softscape, hardscape and planting. · Working knowledge of site QA/QC: ITPs, inspection checklists, NCRs and inspection records. · Strong written and verbal communication in English and/or Arabic; both is an advantage. Preferable · Experience in Saudi Arabia or the wider GCC. · Experience on large-scale land development, infrastructure or public-realm programmes.

7e4a20b3b34d1e13.description: Job Summary Lead and manage worker welfare across Qiddiya's operational environment, ensuring safe, healthy, dignified and compliant living and working conditions for employees, contractors and service providers operating within Qiddiya-controlled assets, venues, precincts, events and public realm environments. Own the development, implementation and assurance of city-wide worker welfare standards, management systems and improvement programmes covering accommodation, transport, catering and food services, hygiene, recreation, wellbeing and workforce support services. Provide operational oversight of welfare performance across multiple assets and service providers, ensuring compliance with applicable legal, regulatory, client and Qiddiya requirements. Partner closely with Operations, Operational Readiness, Facilities Management, HSE, HR, Security, Transport, Procurement and contractor organizations to identify welfare risks, drive corrective actions, support mobilisation and readiness activities, investigate concerns and continuously improve workforce wellbeing outcomes across the city portfolio. Roles and Responsibilities Worker Welfare Governance • Develop, implement, maintain and continuously improve the Qiddiya City Operations Worker Welfare Framework, standards, procedures, management plans and assurance programs. • Own and maintain the Worker Welfare Management Plan for operational assets and city-wide operations, ensuring consistent implementation across all locations, shifts, service providers and contractors. • Ensure worker welfare requirements are integrated into operational policies, contractor management processes, mobilisation activities and operational risk management programs. • Provide subject matter expertise on worker welfare, labor standards and workforce wellbeing matters across City Operations. Operational Assurance & Compliance • Lead a risk-based programme of inspections, audits and assurance activities covering accommodation, welfare facilities, transport, sanitation, water quality, pest control, housekeeping, recreational facilities, wellbeing services and workforce support arrangements. • Lead assurance of contractor and service provider compliance with Qiddiya Worker Welfare Standards through inspections, audits, performance reviews and evidence-based verification activities. • Monitor corrective actions arising from audits, inspections, complaints and investigations and ensure timely, evidenced closure. • Maintain readiness for internal, client and regulatory inspections through effective governance, reporting and record management. Contractor & Service Provider Management • Manage welfare-related contractors and service providers, including accommodation operators, Facilities Management providers, transport contractors, catering providers, cleaning services, security providers and other workforce support functions. • Define welfare requirements, service expectations, SLAs, KPIs and performance standards within contracts and service agreements. • Lead contractor and vendor performance reviews relating to worker welfare and workforce wellbeing, and drive corrective and preventive actions. • Support Procurement and Contractor Management teams during contractor onboarding, mobilisation and ongoing assurance activities. Operational Readiness & Asset Handover • Support operational readiness, mobilisation and asset handover programmes by ensuring worker welfare requirements are incorporated into design reviews, commissioning, mobilisation and go-live activities. • Review workforce accommodation, transport, welfare facilities and support arrangements for new operational assets and services before commencement. • Participate in readiness reviews, stage-gate approvals and operational assurance activities to verify worker welfare controls are in place before assets or services become operational. • Ensure welfare considerations are included within contingency planning and emergency preparedness arrangements. Events & Temporary Workforce Welfare • Provide worker welfare oversight and assurance for temporary, seasonal and event-related workforces operating across Qiddiya-controlled assets, venues, events and public realm environments. • Ensure appropriate welfare arrangements are established for major events, peak operational periods and contractor mobilisation activities. • Monitor and address welfare risks associated with extended working hours, heat stress, transport, accommodation, temporary facilities and workforce support arrangements. Grievance Management & Workforce Engagement • Operate and oversee worker welfare grievance, escalation and reporting mechanisms, including accessible and confidential reporting channels. • Ensure concerns are triaged, investigated and closed promptly, fairly and consistently, with appropriate corrective actions and records. • Analyse trends, identify systemic issues and implement preventative measures to improve workforce wellbeing outcomes. • Promote worker engagement, awareness and wellbeing initiatives across operational environments and contractor workforces. Performance Reporting & Continuous Improvement • Develop and maintain city-wide worker welfare dashboards, KPIs and performance reports covering audit results, accommodation compliance, grievance trends, heat stress controls, contractor compliance, workforce engagement, service quality, non-conformances and corrective action closure. • Provide regular performance, risk and assurance reports to Operations leadership and relevant governance forums, including client updates where required. • Chair or participate in management reviews with Operations, Facilities Management and service providers. • Use performance data, benchmarking, worker feedback and assurance findings to drive continuous improvement across City Operations. Leadership & People Management • Lead and develop the worker welfare team across multiple operational locations and assets, setting clear roles, accountabilities and escalation arrangements. • Establish competency, training and development programmes for welfare personnel and ensure effective coverage across the city portfolio. • Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders, contractors, regulators and external service providers to improve worker welfare outcomes. • Bachelor's degree in Social Sciences, Public Health, Occupational Health & Safety, Facilities Management, Hospitality Management or a related discipline. • Training or certification in worker welfare, labour standards, social compliance, HSE, auditing or facilities management, such as social compliance auditor training, NEBOSH, IOSH or ISO auditing, is preferred. • 7 + years of experience in worker welfare, accommodation or camp operations, social compliance, facilities or property operations, or workforce services within large, multi-site operational environments. • Experience supporting worker welfare programmes within large-scale mixed-use destinations, cities, airports, transport networks, entertainment venues, hospitality environments, operational assets or similar complex operational environments is preferred. • Demonstrated capability in multi-site auditing, evidence-based close-out of corrective actions, vendor and SLA management, grievance handling, contractor assurance, stakeholder engagement and performance reporting. • Experience supporting operational readiness, mobilisation, asset handover, major events or peak operational periods is preferred. • Proactive, self-directed and able to work independently across a dispersed portfolio, using initiative to identify issues early, drive improvements and follow through to closure.
